_about: Basements & Basilisks v0.25: every hero number. Read by the test bench (and later the prototype). Behaviour lives in testbench/behaviour.js. Approved changes through 25 Nov are in.

_howToRead.roll: A roll is { dice, perTier, bonus, low, high }. dice like "2d8" or "1d4+3". perTier: the dice count is multiplied by the hero's tier. bonus: an ability score (its modifier is added) or a number. low/high: what changes on a Low or High ability roll, either "+1"/"-1" dice or a whole new dice string.
_howToRead.byRoll: { low, mid, high } gives a value for each ability-roll result. A natural 20 counts as High and doubles the dice.
_howToRead.job: attack = charges per basic attack; hit = charges when hit (15 per hit); time = charges over time (100 per 5s, faster with INT). Same for everyone in a job.
_howToRead.interval: Seconds between basic attacks. speedScaling: how strongly attack-speed bonuses shorten it (default 1).
_howToRead.chargeToCast: Charge needed to cast (default 100). This sets the ability's size: about 60 small, 100 medium, 180 big, 300 nuke (rules.config.json abilitySizes).
_howToRead.benchJob: Which job benchmark the hero is measured against: frontline, brawler, attacker, caster or support (rules.config.json jobTargets).
_howToRead.size: Ability size: small, medium, big or nuke. Sets chargeToCast and the value each cast should deliver (rules.config.json abilitySizes).
_howToRead.enabled: false switches a hero off everywhere (shop, bot, tests) while keeping their numbers.
_howToRead.startCharge: Charge at the start of a fight; "full" means the hero's whole chargeToCast.

arthur.name: Arthur
arthur._kit: Counter-puncher (Luke, 27 Nov). Action Surge: take an extra weapon attack. Alert: 25% Evasion; when Arthur dodges an attack (Evasion or Alert Strike), he triggers Action Surge, at most once every riposte.cooldown seconds.

channelDivinity.name: Preserve Life
channelDivinity._trigger: Disciple of Life (passive): the first time an ally drops below triggerBelowHp, Bram uses Channel Divinity. One charge per fight, nothing fires at the start.

arcaneRecovery._trigger: Spell Weave (passive): each hit one of her Wards absorbs triggers Arcane Recovery, up to maxPerShield times per Shield.

sneakAttack._trigger: Opportunist (passive): when an ally is attacking the same foe, Wallaby triggers Sneak Attack. Sneak Attack: a bonus Thrown Dagger with +bonus dice, at most once every cooldown seconds.

duelist3.name: Duelist
duelist3._scaling: Each foe he dueled that dies adds +1d8 to his Smite for the rest of the run (carried on the rec).

ability.name: Dread Ambush
ability._note: Corvin (25 Nov): Dread Ambush Marks its target; his twin swords strike twice only against that Marked target. He starts every fight fully charged.
